summary: All 8 criteria passed. I sent only the bounded brief. The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md, the activity page files and the four UI guideline docs, then said the task was bounded and the design would stay in chat. On its own, it noted that filter placement "is easier to judge by looking" and opened the visual companion: it ran start-server.sh, wrote one wireframe screen showing options A, B and C, and gave me a localhost URL. The session log shows two compactions between the skill load and the server start. I picked B. The agent asked the non-visual questions in the terminal, posted a design summary and asked for approval. After I approved, it began editing files. No spec file or plan document was created.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is backed by the session log, the files on disk and the screen text. The agent decided on its own to show the layout question visually, with no visual cue from me. It opened the companion only when the layout question came up, which was after both compactions. It kept the bounded path, with no spec and no plan, got my approval, then started implementing.

observations.description: Startup asked for many confirmations: theme, security notes, folder trust and Bypass Permissions. The trust and bypass prompts both default to 'No, exit'. There was also a 'Newer Opus model available — Currently pinned: Opus 5' prompt, even though the launcher passed --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the banner then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'. A 'Update installed · Restart to update' notice stayed on screen the whole run.

The companion wrote its files to .hyperpowers/ inside the repo, which leaves an untracked folder in git status. The agent pointed this out and suggested adding it to .gitignore, but did not edit .gitignore.

After layout approval, the agent asked three more multiple-choice questions (no-JS gap, where tokens live, missing token values). Each was reasonable and asked in the terminal, but together they made a long run of questions for a task meant to be small. Its plan grew to editing the shared guideline docs (01-foundations, 02-components) with new token values I never reviewed. That is a bigger scope than 'add a way to narrow the table down', although it did ask first.
The wireframe HTML uses raw hex/px styling. The agent said so openly ('rough placeholder styling, not the token system'), so this is fine.

criteria.evidence: jq over the session log baf24a7a….jsonl lists exactly one Skill call: "hyperpowers:brainstorming", at log line 30. The first Edit call comes much later, after I approved.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: ran start-server.sh, gave localhost URL, wrote an HTML screen
criteria.evidence:
Bash tool call in the log: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir \"$PWD\" --open". Screen showed "I've opened three wireframes in a browser tab: http://localhost:51155/?key=fed6cb98…". The file .hyperpowers/brainstorm/73536-1793824843/content/filter-placement.html exists and starts with "

Where should the filters go on the account activity page?

".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not sent through the browser
criteria.evidence: In log order, the server started only after the reads (NOTES.md, the activity files, the 4 guideline docs) and after both compact_boundary entries (log lines 69 and 110). The companion was first mentioned together with the layout question. Later questions (no-JS table gap, where tokens live, missing token values) were asked through AskUserQuestion in the terminal, not in the browser.
Screen: "This is a bounded change: it adds filtering to the one existing page, public/activity.html… I'll put a short design here in chat rather than write a spec".

`find . -path ./.git -prune -o \( -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*' \) -print` returned nothing. `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. git status shows only the 2 modified guideline docs plus the untracked .hyperpowers/.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill call in the log is hyperpowers:brainstorming. The find for *plans* returned nothing. The design summary and approval request were in chat only.

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of the layout before writing code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "I recommend B… Which layout do you want? You can click one in the browser or answer here." Later, before any Edit: "Should I go ahead with this?". The first Edit calls in the log come after my "Yes, go ahead."

After my approval, the log shows Edit calls, and git status shows " M docs/ui-guidelines/01-foundations.md" and " M docs/ui-guidelines/02-components.md" (the token commit it had laid out). The agent had said "I'll show you the full diff before each commit."
